# @ndigo/rate-limit

Fixed-window rate limiting for Node.js — the policy contract, the in-process default limiter, and the shared-store driver seam for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `likeRateLimiter` — Structural type guard for RateLimiter — used where an entry or option is resolved by shape instead of the "context-tokens".RATE_LIMITER token.
- `likeRateLimiterAware` — Tests whether a value looks like rate-limiter-aware state.
- `AsRateLimiterAware` — Mixes rate-limiter awareness into a base class.
- `validateRateLimitPolicy` — Validates a RateLimitPolicy — shared by the `@rateLimit` decorator (decoration-time) and every limiter (call-time).
- `RateLimitPolicy` *(type)* — A route's rate-limit policy: at most `limit` requests per `windowMs` per client key (SEC-6).
- `RateLimitResult` *(type)* — The outcome of RateLimiter.consume.
- `RateLimiter` *(type)* — Rate-limit backend contract. Implementations count request keys over fixed windows; the in-memory reference (single process) and the Redis driver (shared store…
- `RateLimiterAware` *(type)* — Marks an object that can receive a RateLimiter.
- `FixedWindowRateLimiter` — In-memory fixed-window reference implementation: one counter per (key, window) pair, sliding to a fresh window once `windowMs` elapses.
- `RATE_LIMITER` — Token for the application context's shared RateLimiter entry — `NodeAutoConfiguration` registers the in-process default under it; apps needing a shared store o…
